_about: Golden call-note transcripts for extract_disposition. 'today' is frozen per case. 'due_any' options: null, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or {'from','to'} inclusive. 'not_contain' is checked on summary+next_action AFTER strip_financial (what gets stored).
